ABOUT / REDROCK

Choose connections
around your needs.

RED ROCK (HK) LIMITED offers residential, mobile and datacenter proxies. Clear product information and setup guidance help you choose a connection suited to your work.

01 / OUR FOCUS

Start with your needs.
Test in your workflow.

Connections are tools.
Choose with clear requirements.

Tasks have different requirements for network types, locations, session persistence and access methods. REDROCK products reflect these differences: understand the connection type, confirm the settings, then test it in your workflow.

We focus on clear product information, settings you can verify and questions you can describe precisely. Available locations, usage allowances and service conditions depend on the selected product and service agreement.

02 / WHAT WE PROVIDE

Options for different network types.

Understand the proxy type, then check its settings against your requirements.

03 / HOW WE APPROACH IT

Clear information. Informed choices.

These principles guide our products and communication.

01

Define Product Scope

Distinguish proxy types, session behavior and available settings. Base choices on information you can verify; performance in one situation does not predict every task.

02

Test in Context

Connection performance depends on the target service, network and client settings. Small tests with actual tasks help establish whether a product suits your needs.

03

Use Responsibly

Proxies are connection tools. Follow applicable laws, target service terms and access rules, and protect your account and proxy credentials.
